title: ONE MARK GLYPH IN ALL THREE VIEWS
why: The critic found a hollow raid diamond, filled minimap diamond and a different map ring. Spot marks now use the same 24px filled seat-coloured glyph with dark backing in every view. Spot labels sit 4px clear above the glyph with a short leader; entity labels keep their existing safe gap. Watch: the ping and the map mark are one mark. Look for the same amber or cyan diamond and attached label in both windows.
now: Spot marks share one filled diamond across the raid and both maps, with a nearby label.
